title: Glowing bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6c2'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#2a1a40'/>
  <!-- tub body -->
  <path d='M14 46 Q10 46 10 52 L12 74 Q13 82 22 82 L78 82 Q87 82 88 74 L90 52 Q90 46 86 46 Z' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- tub rim -->
  <rect x='8' y='40' width='84' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tub shading -->
  <path d='M14 55 L12 74 Q13 82 22 82 L50 82 L50 55 Z' fill='#c7e0f5'/>
  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M16 52 L84 52 L86 62 Q60 70 50 62 Q40 70 14 62 Z' fill='#3aa6ff'/>
  <path d='M20 58 Q30 63 40 59 Q50 55 60 59 Q70 63 82 57 L84 62 Q60 70 50 62 Q40 70 14 62 Z' fill='#6fc4ff'/>
  <!-- rising bubbles -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='46' r='3' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='38' r='4' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='26' r='3' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='20' r='2' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='2' fill='#cdf0ff'/>
  <!-- glow sparkle above tub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='7' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x='74' y='30' width='7' height='12' rx='2' fill='#b0c8dd'/>
  <path d='M77 30 Q77 22 68 22 L64 22 L64 28 L68 28 Q73 28 73 30 Z' fill='#b0c8dd'/>
  <rect x='62' y='20' width='4' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#9fb6cc'/>
  <!-- drip -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='34' r='1.8' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='20' y='82' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9fb6cc'/>
  <rect x='70' y='82' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9fb6cc'/>
</svg>
